rules.requirement: Owner must obtain a short term rental permit before operating and comply with all applicable permit requirements.
rules.quote: A short term rental permit shall be secured prior to operation; and short term rental operators shall comply with all applicable permit requirements provided in the Code of the City of New Orleans.

rules.requirement: Owner must keep the rental outwardly appearing as a residential dwelling.
rules.quote: The short term rental shall appear outwardly to be a residential dwelling.

rules.requirement: Owner may not allow the rental to be used for commercial or social events.
rules.quote: Use of the short term rental for commercial or social events shall be prohibited.

rules.requirement: Owner may not allow the rental to adversely affect the residential character of the neighborhood through noise, vibrations, garbage, odors or other secondary effects.
rules.quote: The short term rental shall not adversely affect the residential character of the neighborhood by generating excessive noise, vibrations, garbage, odors, or other secondary effects that unreasonably interfere with others' use and enjoyment of their residences, as more fully set forth in standards set outlined in the City Code.

rules.requirement: Owner must have a noise abatement plan and a sanitation plan governing the rental.
rules.quote: A non-commercial short term rental shall be governed by both a noise abatement plan and a sanitation plan.

rules.requirement: Owner may not post any signs for the short term rental.
rules.quote: No signs are allowed for a Non-Commercial Short Term Rental.

rules.requirement: Owner must prominently display the permit on the front facade, visible from the street, showing the permit number, operator contact information, permit type, and bedroom and occupancy limits.
rules.quote: The permit shall be prominently displayed on the front facade of the property in a location clearly visible from the street during all period of occupancy and contain the permit number, the contact information for the operator, the permit type and the bedrooms and occupancy limit.

rules.requirement: Owner must physically reside in a bedroom on the lot during any guest stay and maintain a primary residence on the lot if required.
rules.quote: The operator, who may not be a guest, must physically reside in a bedroom on the lot of record containing the short-term rental during any guest stays and, if required by the City Code, must maintain a primary residence on the lot.

rules.requirement: Owner may not operate more than one non-commercial short term rental.
rules.quote: No person may be the operator of more than one (1) non-commercial short term rental.

rules.requirement: Owner must be onsite during a guest's stay and must respond to complaints within one hour.
rules.quote: The registered operator must be onsite during a guest's stay and must respond to a complaint within one (1) hour of the complaint being made.

rules.requirement: Owner must be a natural person aged 18 or over; ownership by a business entity, trust or other juridical person is prohibited.
rules.quote: Only natural persons aged 18 or over may own property used as a non-commercial short term rental. Ownership, in whole or in part, by a business entity, trust, or any other juridical person is prohibited.

rules.requirement: Owner may not own, in whole or in part, more than one property used as a non-commercial short term rental.
rules.quote: No person may own, in whole or in part, more than one property used as a non-commercial short term rental.

rules.requirement: Owner may not obtain more than one non-commercial short term rental permit per lot.
rules.quote: Only one (1) non-commercial short term rental permit shall be issued for each lot.

rules.requirement: Owner may not operate where another non-commercial short term rental permit has already been issued within the same city block.
rules.quote: Except as provided in Section 21.8.C.18.r, only one (1) non-commercial short term rental permit may be issued within each city block, inclusive of all lots fronting any exterior boundary or said block and all interior lots not fronting the public right of way.

rules.requirement: Owner may rent no more than three guest bedrooms, with occupancy limited to two guests per bedroom and a maximum of six guests.
rules.quote: Up to three (3) guest bedrooms may be rented to guests, and occupancy shall be limited to two (2) guests per guest bedroom with a maximum of six (6) guests.

rules.requirement: Owner must reserve at least one bedroom on the lot exclusively for the operator and may not advertise or use it as a guest bedroom.
rules.quote: At least one bedroom on the lot of record containing a non-commercial short term rental shall be reserved exclusively for the operator and shall not be advertised or used as a guest bedroom.

rules.requirement: Owner may not operate in residential and specified business or mixed-use districts where another bed and breakfast or non-commercial short term rental already exists within the same city block.
rules.quote: In residential districts and HU-B1A Neighborhood Business District, HU-B1 Neighborhood Business District, HU-MU Neighborhood Mixed-Use District, S-LM Lake Area Marina District, MU-1 Medium Intensity Mixed-Use District, and MU-2 High Intensity Mixed-Use District, only one (1) Accessory Bed and Breakfast, one (1) Principal Bed and Breakfast, or one (1) Non-Commercial Short Term Rental is permitted within each city block, inclusive of all lots fronting any exterior boundary of said block and all interior lots not fronting the public right of way.

rules.requirement: Owner may include a second principal building in the rental operation only if it was constructed and used as habitable space at least five years before the short term rental was established.
rules.quote: If more than one (1) principal building exists on a lot, or two (2) or more contiguous lots have been historically acquired together and second building was originally constructed and has been used for habitable space as defined by the Building Code, as least five (5) years prior to the establishment of the short term rental, it may be included in the operation of the short term rental.
